sources.title: SpaceX stock rebounds, closing above $135 IPO price for first time in weeks

checks.explanation: The predicted years-to-15-year rebuild timeline can't be evaluated this early after the 2026 conflict.

Some diffusion has occurred (open-weight models like DeepSeek proliferating across chips/clouds), but the top AI labs and hyperscalers have also continued consolidating enormous compute/capital advantages, so the oligopoly hasn't clearly broken down.
